sentences.zh: 我想我之前在这里和那里都透露过它要问世的暗示，所以最终能把它公开真的太棒了。

sentences.en: Without further ado, let's get into the episode.
sentences.zh: 闲话少说，让我们进入今天的节目。

sentences.en: Today, we are going to be talking about how to create a self-life in your 20s.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要讨论的是如何在二十岁打造一种松弛的生活。

sentences.en: And what I mean by that is how do we create a life of simple pleasures, of joy, one that is gentle, happy, successful, without feeling heavy and frustrating
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们该如何创造一种充满简单快乐、喜悦、温和、幸福且成功的生活，而不会让人觉得沉重和沮丧，

sentences.en: as everything so often feels these days.
sentences.zh: 就像如今凡事常常带给我们的感觉那样。

sentences.en: It is a daily reality for a lot of us in this decade.
sentences.zh: 这是我们这一代人在这个十年里每天都在面对的现实。

sentences.en: We are so focused on progress and success.
sentences.zh: 我们太专注于进步和成功了。

sentences.en: It's been drilled into our brains.
sentences.zh: 这已经被灌输进我们的脑海里。

sentences.en: We are focused on not falling behind on this like predetermined race course that we all are traveling on.
sentences.zh: 我们专注于不要在这场我们都在奔赴的、预设好的赛道上掉队。

sentences.en: And it means that our lives firstly no longer seem like ours and at times they don't even feel enjoyable.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我们的生活首先看起来不再像是我们自己的了，有时甚至让人觉得毫无乐趣可言。

sentences.en: All of our attention and our energy is like focused on work, it's focused on school, it's focused on achievement and it's dictated by like this urgency culture to be doing it all
sentences.zh: 我们所有的注意力和精力都集中在工作上、学校上、成就上，并且被这种必须做到极致、必须现在就拥有一切的“紧迫感文化”所支配，

sentences.en: and to have it all together right now.
sentences.zh: 必须马上一应俱全。

sentences.en: To be rushing from one milestone to the next, from one place to the next.
sentences.zh: 从一个里程碑匆忙赶往下一个，从一个地方奔向下一个地方。

sentences.en: I think it's time that we slow down.
sentences.zh: 我想是时候放慢脚步了。

sentences.en: It's my belief that when we really buy into this during our 20s, this like overarching perspective and attitude towards life and we don't have the occasional reminder
sentences.zh: 我相信，当我们在二十岁时真正全盘接受这种生活态度，这种对生活的大局观和立场，而又没有偶尔的提醒去意识到

sentences.en: that life is short and we actually need to enjoy it, we end up being overwhelmed by unnecessary stress and we prioritize productivity rather than being kind to ourselves,
sentences.zh: 人生苦短、我们其实需要享受生活时，我们最终就会被不必要的压力压得喘不过气来，并且把追求高效率置于善待自己、

sentences.en: being gentle to ourselves,
sentences.zh: 温柔对待自己、

sentences.en: experiencing the world.
sentences.zh: 体验世界之上。

sentences.en: Shaking off that philosophy as well, it becomes harder the older we get.
sentences.zh: 而且随着年龄增长，摆脱这种理念也会变得越来越难。

sentences.en: So it's a very formative period where we can rewrite the script that we have been taught on how to enjoy our lives.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个非常关键的形成期，我们可以重写被灌输的关于如何享受生活的剧本。

sentences.en: That is what we want.
sentences.zh: 这正是我们想要的。

sentences.en: We do not want to be operating at this really high stress frequency
sentences.zh: 我们不想在接下来的三十、四0年里

sentences.en: for, you know, the next 30, 40 years and never slowing down.
sentences.zh: 一直处于这种极高压的频率中生活，却从不放慢脚步。

sentences.en: I think it also comes down to this very important thing to remember, which is that in a culture of hustling and in the culture of success, you don't need to burn out
sentences.zh: 我认为这也归结于一个非常重要、需要牢记的事实，那就是在内卷文化和崇尚成功的文化中，你不需要通过精疲力竭

sentences.en: to prove that you deserve good things.
sentences.zh: 来证明你值得拥有美好的事物。

sentences.en: You don't need to deny yourself simple pleasures to prove you're a good person.
sentences.zh: 你不需要剥夺自己体验简单快乐的权利来证明你是个好人。

sentences.en: We want to take a more, I would say, positive psychology approach.
sentences.zh: 我想我们可以采取一种更加积极心理学的方法。

sentences.en: We want to take our mental health and our emotional health seriously by deliberately choosing and pursuing a soft life.
sentences.zh: 我们要通过刻意选择和追求松弛的生活，来认真对待我们的心理健康和情绪健康。

sentences.en: The soft life is about slowing down.
sentences.zh: 松弛的生活意味着放慢脚步。

sentences.en: It's about adopting a lifestyle of enjoyment, comfort, ease, simple pleasure and it came from the Nigerian wellness community and from black female creators
sentences.zh: 它意味着采纳一种享受、舒适、安逸、简单快乐的生活方式，它源自尼日利亚的健康社群和黑人女性创作者，

sentences.en: who were sharing this new approach in the last two to three years that really combines agency, ambition, freedom without the need to sacrifice what you enjoy
sentences.zh: 她们在过去两到三年里分享了这种全新的方法，真正将自主权、雄心、自由结合在一起，而无需牺牲你所热爱的事物，

sentences.en: and to always put others above you, put yourself under this intense stress.
sentences.zh: 也无需总是把别人排在自己前面、让自己承受这种巨大的压力。

sentences.en: You go easier on yourself.
sentences.zh: 对你自己好一点。

sentences.en: You appreciate the details of life rather than rushing through them.
sentences.zh: 去欣赏生活中的细节，而不是匆匆忙忙地把它们过完。

sentences.en: If you want to read about the exact history of this term, there is an amazing article by Anscape which is like an online journal titled,
sentences.zh: 如果你想了解这个词的确切历史，Anscape（一个在线期刊）上有一篇精彩的文章，

sentences.en: The Soft Life Isn't As Easy As It Looks Online and they interview some of the originators of this term.
sentences.zh: 题为《松弛生活并没有网上传的那么简单》，他们在文中采访了一些该词的原创者。

sentences.en: It's incredibly fascinating for where their desire to embrace the soft life and promote the soft life really came from.
sentences.zh: 对于他们拥抱松弛生活和推广松弛生活的愿望最初是如何产生的，这真的非常引人入胜。

sentences.en: I like to think of it as well as really living similarly to how our ancestors would have lived long ago.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢把它想象成一种类似于我们祖先很久以前的生活方式。

sentences.en: They would have woken with the sun.
sentences.zh: 他们伴着太阳醒来。

sentences.en: They would have felt their feet on the earth.
sentences.zh: 他们能感受到双脚踩在大地上的触感。

sentences.en: They would have watched the trees move, watched the sunset, enjoyed like the sweetness of the berries, really savored it.
sentences.zh: 他们看着树木摇曳，看着日落，享受着浆果的甘甜，细细品味这一切。

sentences.en: They would have done just what they needed to survive and then rest easy at night with their clan.
sentences.zh: 他们只做生存所必需的事情，然后在夜晚与族人安心休憩。

sentences.en: They didn't have to-do lists.
sentences.zh: 他们没有待办清单。

sentences.en: They didn't have Teams meetings.
sentences.zh: 他们没有Teams会议。

sentences.en: They didn't have Microsoft Word.
sentences.zh: 他们没有微软Word。

sentences.en: They didn't have keynote presentations that needed to be done for their boss and this soft life is about appreciating that obviously circumstances have changed so we need jobs.
sentences.zh: 他们不需要为老板赶制keynote演示文稿，而这种松弛的生活就是去体会到，显然环境变了，所以我们需要工作。

sentences.en: We have these responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 我们有这些责任。

sentences.en: This is an element of who we are but choosing to return to a life before productivity defined us in the time that we have.
sentences.zh: 这是我们的一部分，但在我们拥有的时间内，选择回归一个在被“高效率”定义之前的纯粹生活。

sentences.en: We want comfort.
sentences.zh: 我们渴望舒适。

sentences.en: We want low stress.
sentences.zh: 我们渴望低压力。

sentences.en: So let us jump into five ways you can really create that life for yourself at this pivotal point how you can reprogram, re-socialize, retrain your brain to see this
sentences.zh: 所以让我们切入正题，看看你在这个转折点上可以真正为自己创造这种生活的五种方法，如何重塑大脑、重构社交、训练大脑将其视为

sentences.en: as the version of success you should be pursuing and talk about the psychology behind it.
sentences.zh: 你应追求的成功版本，并探讨其背后的心理学。

sentences.en: Talk about the mental impact.
sentences.zh: 探讨其对心理的影响。

sentences.en: All of that and more after this short break.
sentences.zh: 在简短的休息之后，我们将揭晓所有这些以及更多内容。

sentences.en: There are of course a few straightforward ways to embrace a soft life that we hear about quite frequently.
sentences.zh: 当然，有一些我们经常听到的、拥抱松弛生活的直接方法。

sentences.en: You know, prioritize self-care especially self-care that isn't just about self-improvement but a genuine generosity to yourself.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，优先进行自我关怀，尤其是那种不仅关乎自我提升、更是发自内心善待自己的关怀。

sentences.en: Setting boundaries with people or situations which are emotionally taxing.
sentences.zh: 与那些在情感上消耗你的人或情况划清界限。

sentences.en: Another important one.
sentences.zh: 另一个重要的方法。

sentences.en: Practicing gratitude,
sentences.zh: 练习感恩，

sentences.en: incorporating rest, treating yourself every now and again.
sentences.zh: 融入休息，偶尔犒劳一下自己。

sentences.en: All very important.
sentences.zh: 这些都非常重要。

sentences.en: All pretty well known for a good reason.
sentences.zh: 而且有充分的理由让它们广为人知。

sentences.en: But with that in mind I really want to focus on five more specific things that are a little bit different and that you can do daily, weekly, monthly that have an evidence base
sentences.zh: 但在此基础上，我真正想聚焦于另外五个更具体、略有不同且你可以每天、每周、每月进行、背后有科学依据的方法。

sentences.en: behind them.
sentences.zh: 支撑。

sentences.en: The most significant one in my mind, in my opinion, comes down to gratitude.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，最重要的一点归结于感恩。

sentences.en: And that is number one.
sentences.zh: 这就是第一点。

sentences.en: Go searching for joy.
sentences.zh: 去寻找快乐。

sentences.en: Go searching for things to savor and embrace the kind of little things that are presented to you every day.
sentences.zh: 去寻找那些值得品味的事物，去拥抱每天呈现在你面前的点滴美好。

sentences.en: Savor, you know, the crunchiness of the apple that you had for breakfaSt.
sentences.zh: 品味吧，比如早餐吃的那口苹果的清脆感。

sentences.en: Savor the fact that you found that perfect shower temperature, your cup of coffee, the little kid like giggling on your bus, the joy of your daily walk.
sentences.zh: 品味你找到了完美的淋浴水温、你的那杯咖啡、公交车上小孩子的咯咯笑声、每日散步带来的快乐。

sentences.en: You know, wake up without an alarm once a week.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，每周不设闹钟醒来一次。

sentences.en: Choose a slower pace for your meals.
sentences.zh: 在吃饭时选择更慢的节奏。

sentences.en: Reconnect.
sentences.zh: 重新建立连接。

sentences.en: Joy as an emotion is so overlooked and so often confused with happiness as well but it's a lot deeper.
sentences.zh: 作为一种情绪，快乐常常被忽视，也经常与幸福混淆，但它要深邃得多。

sentences.en: It's a lot more profound.
sentences.zh: 它要深刻得多。

sentences.en: Joy is elation.
sentences.zh: 快乐是兴高采烈。

sentences.en: It's delight.
sentences.zh: 它是欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: It's like this whole body experience of synchronicity.
sentences.zh: 它就像是一种身心合一的共鸣体验。

sentences.en: Almost like, you know, the best way I can explain it is the sense that in that moment you exist right now just to experience this.
sentences.zh: 差不多就像，我能解释的最好方式就是那种感觉：此刻你存在于世，就为了体验这一刻。

sentences.en: This is the reason you were put on this world.
sentences.zh: 这就是你被带到这个世界的理由。

sentences.en: This is such a human experience to feel joy.
sentences.zh: 感受快乐是极其人性化的体验。

sentences.en: This is what we're here for.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们来到这里的意义。

sentences.en: Here is the thing.
sentences.zh: 事情是这样的。

sentences.en: The more you go searching for joy, the more it tends to find you even when you don't want it to because once our brain starts searching for a certain kind of stimulus moment thing,
sentences.zh: 你越是去寻找快乐，它往往越会找到你，哪怕你并不想要它，因为一旦我们的大脑开始寻找某种特定类型的刺激或事物，

sentences.en: like a joyful thing, it becomes naturally more attuned to the presence of such things in our environment.
sentences.zh: 比如快乐的事物，它就会自然而然地对我们环境中此类事物的存在更加敏感。

sentences.en: So noticing joy makes joy more evident in your everyday.
sentences.zh: 所以，注意到快乐会使快乐在你的日常生活中更加显现。

sentences.en: It's kind of like when you notice a yellow car and you can't stop noticing them.
sentences.zh: 这有点像当你注意到一辆黄色的车，然后你就忍不住总能看到它们。

sentences.en: Like there is this green car near my house.
sentences.zh: 就像我房子附近有这样一辆绿色的车。

sentences.en: It's like a lime green car and now anytime
sentences.zh: 那是一辆青柠绿的车，现在每当

sentences.en: I'm in a new city, a new suburb, sometimes even a new country, I see that car everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我在一个新的城市、一个新的郊区，有时甚至是一个新的国家时，我到处都能看到那辆车。

sentences.en: I always notice it being around.
sentences.zh: 我总是注意到它在附近。

sentences.en: Having that search for joy, that personal search for joy is really, really helpful for your health and your life satisfaction.
sentences.zh: 去寻找快乐，那种对快乐的个人寻找，对你的健康和生活满意度真的非常非常有用。

sentences.en: So there was a study published by the
sentences.zh: 因此，有一项由

sentences.en: Royal College of Surgeons in Ireland and it found that when we regularly experience joy day to day, something we take for granted, something we don't tend to focus on
sentences.zh: 爱尔兰皇家外科医学院发布的研究发现，当我们日常生活中经常体验到快乐时——这是我们视为理所当然的事，是我们往往不会在健康文献中关注的事——

sentences.en: in health literature, it triggers a number of psychological but also physical changes.
sentences.zh: 它会引发一系列心理以及生理上的变化。

sentences.en: Better blood flow, better focus, a better mood, all things that make for a softer life.
sentences.zh: 更好的血流量、更好的专注力、更好的心情，所有这些都能造就更温柔的生活。

sentences.en: Now, that was one study but there was another one from 2019 that was a research paper that is the perfect example of how embracing joy makes you more holistically well.
sentences.zh: 好了，那是一项研究，但2019年还有另一项研究，那是一篇完美的学术论文，展示了拥抱快乐如何让你在整体上更加健康。

sentences.en: So this paper measured the impact of an intervention called Picture This.
sentences.zh: 所以这篇论文测量了一项名为“拍下这个”（Picture This）的干预措施的影响。

sentences.en: I love this intervention.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢这项干预措施。

sentences.en: It's very similar to the exercise that I'm going to talk about in just a second but in the Picture This study the researchers asked 200 of their participants in the experimental
sentences.zh: 它与我马上要谈到的练习非常相似，但在“拍下这个”的研究中，研究人员要求实验组中的200名参与者

sentences.en: condition to use their smartphones to take at least two photographs of an event, moment, place that made them feel joyful and they had to do this each day for three weeks
sentences.zh: 使用他们的智能手机，为那些让他们感到快乐的事件、时刻、地方拍摄至少两张照片，他们必须在三周内每天都这样做，

sentences.en: and then they uploaded those photographs to a server for the staff to kind of look at.
sentences.zh: 然后他们将这些照片上传到一个服务器上，供工作人员进行查看。

sentences.en: So the researchers gave them some examples of like things to take photos of.
sentences.zh: 因此，研究人员给他们提供了一些拍照内容的事例。

sentences.en: You know, you could take a photo of the sky at sunset, you could take a photo of a good friend, of getting a really good grade on a paper or a test that you worked hard for.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你可以拍一张日落时天空的照片，你可以拍一张好朋友的照片，或者拍一张你努力准备的论文或测试得了高分的照片。

sentences.en: They were also instructed, this is the second part, they were instructed to focus on the physical sensations and the cognitive and emotional response that they had in that moment
sentences.zh: 他们还接到指示，这是第二部分，他们被指示要关注他们在决定拍照的那一刻所产生的身体感觉以及认知和情绪反应。

sentences.en: that they decided to take a photograph.
sentences.zh: 他们决定拍下一张照片。

sentences.en: This is actually called sensory perceptual sharpening, noticing how your senses respond to something that you're perceiving.
sentences.zh: 这实际上被称为“感觉知觉敏锐化”，即注意你的感官如何对你所感知的事物做出反应。

sentences.en: Basically, what they were doing in this not so sly way was forcing their participants to take note and take notice of joy and capture a photo of the source.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他们用这种并不隐蔽的方式所做的事情，是迫使参与者注意并察觉快乐，并拍摄下快乐源头的照片。

sentences.en: Over that period, all these 200 people, their mood improved, they became more grateful, more motivated, they expressed that they enjoyed their life more.
sentences.zh: 在那段时间里，这200个人的情绪都有所改善，他们变得更加感恩、更有动力，他们表达了对自己生活更多的享受。

sentences.en: For some people, it was actually quite a profound experience.
sentences.zh: 对有些人来说，这实际上是一次相当深刻的体验。

sentences.en: They were like, I just didn't realize how much beauty my life had.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得：“我之前简直没有意识到我的生活有这么多的美。”

sentences.en: It really seems to show that daily experiences of awe, curiosity, gratitude, love.
sentences.zh: 这确实表明，日常对敬畏、好奇、感恩、爱的体验，

sentences.en: That can put the average person on a trajectory of growth, success, and we know that a soft life is about being present and immersed in experiencing whatever you get
sentences.zh: 可以把一个普通人带入一条成长和成功的轨迹，而且我们知道，所谓温柔的生活，就是活在当下，沉浸在体验你所得到的任何

sentences.en: the privilege to enjoy and whatever you get the experience to feel.
sentences.zh: 有幸享受的事物以及你所体验到的任何感受中。

sentences.en: Taking inspiration from that study, and I love this study.
sentences.zh: 从那项研究中汲取灵感——我太喜欢这项研究了。

sentences.en: I've talked about this on the podcast before and I've talked about it on Instagram, but I have my own version of Picture This and it's called
sentences.zh: 我以前在播客里谈过这个，也在Instagram上谈过，但我有我自己的“拍下这个”版本，它叫做

sentences.en: The Smile File.
sentences.zh: “微笑档案”（The Smile File）。

sentences.en: Some people also have a ta-da liSt.
sentences.zh: 有些人还有一个“完成清单”（ta-da list）。

sentences.en: These are your only instructions.
sentences.zh: 这些就是你的全部指示。

sentences.en: Very similar to that exercise, once a day, all you have to do is take a photo, screenshot, or take a note of something that has brought you joy or something that has seemed
sentences.zh: 与那个练习非常相似，一天一次，你所需要做的就是拍一张照片、截个图，或者记下一件给你带来快乐的事，或者一件对你来说

sentences.en: so magical to you.
sentences.zh: 如此神奇的事。

sentences.en: Almost like someone has placed this thing in your life and gone like, ta-da, look at it, enjoy it, I made this for you.
sentences.zh: 几乎就像有人把这东西放在你的生活中，然后说：“铛铛，看这个，享受它，这是我为你做的。”

sentences.en: Savor that moment, find one moment every single day, focus on the sensations.
sentences.zh: 细细品味那一刻，每天都找到这样一个时刻，专注于那些感觉。

sentences.en: I think life becomes so much easier to enjoy and it's so much more gentle when you have this like outside armor of gratitude, when that is the first thing that any experience
sentences.zh: 我认为，当你拥有这种感恩的外部盔甲时，生活会变得容易享受得多，也温柔得多；当任何朝你扑面而来的经历都必须

sentences.en: that, you know, comes at you will have to penetrate, an armor of gratitude.
sentences.zh: 穿透这样一层感恩的盔甲时。

sentences.en: So, moving on from that, our second step for adopting a soft way of living and a soft way of flourishing in our 20s, every single day I want you to remove two things
sentences.zh: 所以，接下来，我们采用一种温柔的生活方式以及在20多岁时温柔绽放的第二个步骤是：每天从你的待办事项清单中删掉两件

sentences.en: from your to-do list that you cannot do.
sentences.zh: 你无法完成的事情。

sentences.en: Let me tell you, there is a lot we can do in a day.
sentences.zh: 让我告诉你，我们在一天之内能做的事情有很多。

sentences.en: There is 24 hours, that's a lot of time, but there is a lot more that we actually don't need to do.
sentences.zh: 有24个小时，那是很多时间，但实际上有更多的事情我们根本不需要去做。

sentences.en: We actually never need to do.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上永远不需要去做。

sentences.en: We just convince ourselves that we're lazy if we don't do it.
sentences.zh: 我们只是说服自己，如果我们不做，我们就是懒惰的。

sentences.en: If you grew up in an environment where you were called lazy for relaxing or you were an overachiever, every single piece of your worth was tied to what you can do in a day,
sentences.zh: 如果你在一个因放松而被骂懒惰的环境中长大，或者你曾经是个追求完美的人，那么你的每一分价值都与你在一天内能做的事、

sentences.en: your grades, how impressive you looked,
sentences.zh: 你的成绩、你看上去有多优秀挂钩，

sentences.en: you know, these days you may feel quite an intense internal conflict or guilt when you aren't busy.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如今当你不够忙碌时，你可能会感到一种强烈的内心冲突或内疚感。

sentences.en: And so, you feel like you have to earn your rest by creating more tasks, more challenges for yourself day in and day out.
sentences.zh: 因此，你会觉得你必须通过日复一日为自己创造更多任务、更多挑战来换取休息。

sentences.en: But the idea of being quote-unquote lazy, it has no place in our soft era because reducing your stress by reducing how much you have to do, it's actually not laziness,
sentences.zh: 但是所谓“懒惰”的概念，在我们的温柔时代里是没有容身之地的，因为通过减少要做的事情来减轻压力，这其实不是懒惰，

sentences.en: it's deliberate, it's actually quite hard to do and it is about providing yourself with space to be human rather than just being a product of how much output you can produce.
sentences.zh: 这是刻意为之，其实挺难做到的，这是为了给自己留出作为人类的空间，而不是仅仅沦为你能产出多少成果的产物。

sentences.en: Another version of that, so you can remove two things from your list today, this is a version of that that I swear by
sentences.zh: 这是它的另一个版本，所以你今天可以从你的清单上删掉两件物品，这是我深信不疑的它的一个版本，

sentences.en: and what I do is I have my to-do list and that is the things
sentences.zh: 我的做法是，我有一个待办事项清单，那里面都是

sentences.en: I really need to do.
sentences.zh: 我真正需要做的事情。

sentences.en: Couldn't do them any other day, essential for my job, essential for living, essential for being a good friend, being a good partner, paying taxes, you know, those kind of things.
sentences.zh: 换作任何其他一天都做不了，对我的工作必不可少，对生存必不可少，对做一个好朋友、好伴侣、交税必不可少，你知道的，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: That's my to-do liSt.
sentences.zh: 那就是我的待办事项清单。

sentences.en: Then I have my I would like to-do liSt.
sentences.zh: 然后我有我的“我想做”清单（I would like to-do list）。

sentences.en: This is the things that I would really kind of like to get done, I would really like to get around to, it's not going to be the end of the world if I don't do it.
sentences.zh: 这里面是我真的很想抽空去完成的事情，如果没做的话也不是世界末日。

sentences.en: And then I have my extras liSt.
sentences.zh: 然后我还有我的“额外”清单（extras list）。

sentences.en: This is the things that I would do if I have like a shit ton of time, but none of those things are essential.
sentences.zh: 这里面是我如果有大量空闲时间才会去做的事情，但这些事情都不是必不可少的。

sentences.en: Anything on my I would like to or my extras list doesn't need to be done today or tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我的“我想做”或“额外”清单上的任何事情，今天或明天都不需要完成。

sentences.en: Eventually they might even fall off the list altogether and nothing's going to go wrong.
sentences.zh: 最终它们甚至可能会从清单上彻底消失，也不会出什么差错。

sentences.en: So you have your must list, your I would like list and your extra liSt.
sentences.zh: 所以你拥有你的“必须”清单、“我想做”清单和“额外”清单。

sentences.en: Why is this important?
sentences.zh: 为什么这很重要？

sentences.en: Well, too often, and I'm guilty of this as well, but too often we put every single small thing on our to-do list from our small tasks to our large ambitions and it's just
sentences.zh: 好吧，很多时候——我自己也对此感到内疚——但很多时候，我们把每一个小事，从微小的任务到巨大的野心，全都塞进待办事项清单里，这

sentences.en: not helpful.
sentences.zh: 毫无帮助。

sentences.en: I do think that we tend to do this as a way of organizing or structuring our thoughts and a way of visualizing and finding a space for remembering what needs to get done,
sentences.zh: 我确实认为，我们往往把这作为一种整理或构建思维的方式，作为一种可视化并找到空间来记住什么需要完成的方法，

sentences.en: but it has the ripple on effect of making us insanely overwhelmed because we have no vetting process.
sentences.zh: 但它会产生连锁反应，让我们感到疯狂的不知所措，因为我们没有筛选机制。

sentences.en: We have no vetting process as to what actually deserves to be on our daily agenda.
sentences.zh: 我们没有任何机制来筛选什么才真正配得上进入我们的每日议程。

sentences.en: It's like everything from do the dishes to find my birth certificate to get a new job to like insert huge task here.
sentences.zh: 这就好比从“洗碗”到“找出生证明”再到“找一份新工作”以及“在此插入巨大任务”的所有事情都混在一起。

sentences.en: Because of this we never actually finish the to-do liSt.
sentences.zh: 正因为如此，我们实际上永远完成不了待办事项清单。

sentences.en: Every day a new task is kind of carried over.
sentences.zh: 每天总有一些新的任务被结转过来。

sentences.en: You add on more items which you can't do anyways, then you don't do them, you feel like a failure even when you already did all the things that you already needed to do.
sentences.zh: 你不断添加更多无论如何也做不完的项目，然后你没有完成它们，哪怕你已经做完了所有真正需要做的事情，你还是觉得自己是个失败者。

sentences.en: So why is it important to have a realistic list rather than an ambitious list?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么拥有一份现实的清单，而不是雄心勃勃的清单如此重要？

sentences.en: It's because of how our brains prioritize and think about unfinished tasks.
sentences.zh: 这是因为我们的大脑如何对未完成的任务进行优先排序和思考。

sentences.en: They become rather intrusive.
sentences.zh: 它们变得相当具有侵扰性。

sentences.en: There is a natural spotlight on everything that we haven't done rather than on what we have done.
sentences.zh: 我们自然而然地会将聚光灯打在我们还没做的事情上，而不是已经做过的事情上。

sentences.en: So this is due to a psychological phenomena known as the zygonic effect, which basically says that we tend to fixate on interrupted tasks or incomplete tasks more than others.
sentences.zh: 所以这是由于一种被称为“蔡格尼克记忆效应”（zygonic effect）的心理现象，它基本上说明，比起其他事情，我们往往对被打断的任务或未完成的任务更加执着。

sentences.en: When we feel like we have, I hate using this word, but failed to do something, something that we needed to do, this creates this underlying cognitive tension and it means that our
sentences.zh: 当我们觉得——我很讨厌用这个词——但当我们觉得自己在做某件需要做的事情上“失败”了，这就产生了一种潜在的认知紧张，这意味着我们的

sentences.en: brain keeps coming back to it, keeps saying hey we haven't finished that yet, we haven't finished that yet.
sentences.zh: 大脑会不断回想起它，不断说：“嘿，我们还没搞定那个呢，我们还没搞定那个呢。”

sentences.en: Even as you're trying to switch off, even as you're trying to fall asleep, even when you are totally exhausted,
sentences.zh: 哪怕在你正试图关机时，哪怕在你正试图入睡时，哪怕当你精疲力竭时，

sentences.en: even when actually there's no need to do that thing today.
sentences.zh: 哪怕实际上今天根本没有必要去做那件事。

sentences.en: In some ways this is sometimes helpful, you know when you're really under the pump, you don't want to forget things, you don't want things to slip off the list, but you are
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，这有时是有帮助的，你知道的，当你压力极大时，你不想忘记事情，你不想让事情从清单上溜走，但是你
